INTERNAL_EDGES.what_you_must_verify_rather_than_assume: 🔴 Same laboratory and same model class do NOT by themselves establish that the evidence is dependent. Check, from the artefacts, whether these two papers reuse the SAME data, samples, cohorts, animals or experiments — a shared mouse line is not a shared experiment, and a shared experiment is not an independent replication. Distinguish independence OF THE DATA from replication PERFORMED BY AN EXTERNAL GROUP. Whatever you find, state it as a finding with its evidence; do not infer dependence from the author list.

M1 acquisition — structured surface first, into the shared checkout's gitignored files/, SHA-256 per artefact, route recorded so someone with another checkout can replay it
M2 reading — section by section, every available figure as an image at native resolution, surface inventory before the figures, locators captured while the document is open
M3 manifest — schema v2, strict validator PASS with zero gaps, plus paper_packet.py check
M4 receipt — through fulltext_receipts.py record, then verify
M4b comparison — a SEPARATE phase, opened only after the receipt has landed, against whole records from registry_records.py, with comparison_check.py facts and check run before the note is written
M5 dossier, commit candidate where a registry record or claim is touched, discovery-ledger append where a lead emerges
M6 joint synthesis of the two papers — only after both receipts exist, and it must answer the data-independence question above
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Per PMID: deepdive_manifest.py --pmid <PMID> --verify-artifacts --require-current-schema exits PASS with 0 gaps, run against the shared root checkout.

Per PMID: fulltext_receipts.py record succeeded and verify is OK afterwards; coverage values are honest — captions_only, unavailable and not_read are used where true, and a complete read carries no not_read.

The abstract is never the evidentiary surface for any locator.

COMMITTING.how: bash scripts/legend_commit.sh "<message>" <path> [<path> ...] — never git commit directly; several actors share this checkout. One commit per finished paper.
COMMITTING.never: No push. No write into another actor's files. A red caused by a peer's file is reported, not fixed. files/ is gitignored by design: the evidence lives there, the manifest that fingerprints it is what gets committed.
COMMITTING.derived_surfaces: Do NOT regenerate shared derived surfaces (batch_queue.md, coverage_report.md, reading_state.md, the pathograph) — the orchestrator does that at wave close, and regeneration is refused while any input is uncommitted.

REVIEW_REQUIREMENT: Ladder floor R2. R4 / legend-locator-audit is REQUIRED before any reading is allowed to narrow, reverse, corroborate or remove a consolidated baseline claim, or to justify a MAJOR working-model bump — and CLAIM 006 and CLAIM 007 are consolidated baseline, so a reading of 36828035 that touches either crosses that trigger. The blind locator audit is also the fourth mandatory trigger on any contradicted persisted locator, whatever the claim status.

RETRY_POLICY.on_exhaust: PARK that single surface with a written acquisition cascade — routes tried and each literal response — and continue with the rest of the paper and with the other PMID. An inaccessible source is an explicit limit on corpus completeness, never a reason to stop the lot and never a reason to simulate a reading.

STOP_POLICY_REMINDER: §21c governs. You stop for two reasons only: an act reserved to the operator with no sanctioned alternative, or a condition with no safe default. Reserved and therefore never yours: any push, history rewrite, deletion of unique material, external spend of any kind (no PaperQA2, no API-keyed or paid retrieval), modification of the four current files or disease_model.md, BATCH_COMMIT. Everything else has a safe default: take it, record it in DEFAULTS_TAKEN, continue. Closing your turn to report while a paper of your lot remains unworked is itself a class-3 stop; running out of context is the one honest reason to stop and is said in one line as that reason.

joint_synthesis.verdict: INDEPENDENT DATA · SHARED MODEL · NOT AN EXTERNAL REPLICATION
joint_synthesis.evidence: Different genotype arm (homozygote vs heterozygote-only), different animals, different institution and IACUC (MD Anderson vs Indiana University), different challenge (none vs LPS 10 mg/kg), different timepoints (80/250 d vs a single 12 h), no shared endpoint. Shared: the mouse LINE - 'generously donated by CMarcelo Aldaz' - and one author. A shared reagent is not a shared experiment; and because the originating senior author co-authors the second paper and the second inherits the first's baseline premise by citation, it is not an external replication either.
joint_synthesis.consequence: DL-MECH-012's tag 'DATO (convergente su >=3 modelli)' does not survive as counted: three tissues of ONE laboratory's axis, one leg an unreviewed preprint. Direction survives; the count must stop being quoted as three-model confirmation. DL-REPO-002 justifies its direction with the same count and is named for the same reason.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The blind-pass firewall for 36828035 was compromised before the first paper was opened: fulltext_receipts.py status --pmid, which the standing brief names as the authority on raw events, returns the prior receipts INCLUDING their evidence_basis prose, so the resumption saw the 2026-08 findings.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Disclosed it in TASK_ACK before any reading rather than discovering it afterwards, continued, and recorded it as an incident in the diagnosis.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The dispatch ordered a RESUMPTION of this paper, not a blind first read, and the firewall item that carries the real risk - the other paper's findings - stayed intact: nothing about 39868255 was read before its own acquisition.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: A truly blind resumption would need the packet alone and a status command that separates events from findings. That is a harness observation, recorded, not acted on in a reading task.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Reading the two papers sequentially with one reader means paper 2's pass necessarily has paper 1 in context.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Followed the dispatch's explicit order (36828035 to its receipt first, then 39868255, then the joint synthesis) and disclosed the residual limitation.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The order was mandated, and the separation that matters was preserved: paper 2's manifest and dossier were written from its own artefacts, and its two citation defects were found by checking IT against the source, not by importing the source's conclusions.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: Genuine mutual blindness needs two readers and a PARALLEL_READ_GROUP, which the contract explicitly declined for this lot.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: bioRxiv refused every route with HTTP 429 'error code: 1015' for roughly 25 minutes, under both User-Agent policies.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Treated 1015 as a rate limit rather than a refusal, backed off, ran other work, and retried with increasing delay - including one background retry loop at 95-second intervals.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The status code is a documented Cloudflare rate limit, the recorded cascade already showed the paper was expected to be available, and no spend or credential was involved. It worked: all three surfaces landed.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: Parking on the first 429 would have declared a fully available paper unreachable and produced a partial receipt for no reason.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Nine figure files fetched from the bioRxiv web raster route were 17-byte Cloudflare stubs, and the extracted native image streams of the PDF figures were single layers rendering mostly black.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Deleted both sets from files/ rather than declaring them, and recorded WHY in the manifest and dossier.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: Both are derivable on demand and neither is unique material: the stubs are error bodies and the layers are reproducible from the declared PDF by one command. Declaring either as a figure artefact would have put a surface in the manifest that cannot support the attestation beside it.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: A later actor finding ten black PNGs named 'native' would reasonably conclude the figures had been inspected.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The preprint had no entry anywhere in full_text_queue_current.md, so its 8 unresolved gene-direct references had no lawful queue address and manifest_queue_id_crosscheck refuses a foreign one.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Created FT-097 for this paper and pointed multihop.queued at it.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The queue is research-layer, append-only in practice, and is NOT one of the four scientific current files; LINT stayed PASS. The alternative - debt in prose only - is the failure the brief names explicitly.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: The debt would have lived in a dossier paragraph and been invisible to every queue query.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: comparison_check.py facts for 39868255 reported 'manifest validator: exit 1 - NOT A PASS' from a check_runs cache written before the final manifest fix.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Refreshed the cached check run and re-derived the facts block before writing the M4b note.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The live validator returned PASS with 0 gaps; pasting the stale block would have put a technical statement in the note that the artefacts contradict.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: Exactly the defect the facts block exists to prevent, committed by the command meant to prevent it.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: erratum_scope_check returned SCOPE_UNDECLARED on both papers, neither of which has any notice.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Declared corrected_items as an explicitly EMPTY list on both manifests, with the reason, rather than leaving an unanswerable question. This amended the already-committed 36828035 manifest in the paper-2 commit, named there explicitly.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: An empty declared scope is a true statement about both papers and turns an unanswerable check into CLEAR / NO_ERRATUM_RECORDED. No locator or coverage value changed; the contradiction audit reports entry_field_changes=0 for it.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: Two manifests would keep reporting a question that cannot be answered, which the tool deliberately reports as loudly as a hit.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: paper_packet.py check reports `flag drift` as INSUFFICIENT_DATA / exit 2 on both papers, because a declared-effort flag cannot drift across a single manifest revision.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Recorded it as 'established nothing' everywhere it appears - diagnosis, both M4b notes - and never as a pass.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: It is a true statement of what the screen did. The rule is explicit: a non-zero exit is not a pass and may not be reported as one.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: Reporting '4 of 4 checks green' would have been false on both papers.
